nodes.summary: The mean coalescence time `T₁ = d + (d - 1) / M` of two lineages in different demes (units of `2N` generations). Meaningful for `M > 0`; `betweenTime d 0 = d` is a junk value (the true mean is infinite).
nodes.title: Mean coalescence time between demes

nodes.summary: The total rate `qₛ = ∑ₜ q(s, t)` of leaving the state `s`.
nodes.title: Exit rate of a structured-coalescent state

nodes.summary: For `d ≥ 2` demes and `M = 4Nm > 0`, the first-step equations have the unique solution `T₀ = d`, `T₁ = d + (d - 1) / M`. In particular `T₀` does not depend on the migration rate.
nodes.title: Mean coalescence times in the finite island model (Strobeck 1987; Slatkin 1991)

nodes.summary: The first-step (backward Kolmogorov) equations for the mean time to coalescence: `h coalesced = 0`, and at each transient state `s`, `∑ₜ q(s, t) (h t - h s) = -1`. (The vector of mean absorption times of a finite absorbing continuous-time Markov chain satisfies these equations; this file does not construct the chain.)
nodes.title: First-step equations for mean coalescence time

nodes.summary: At each transient state `s` the exit rate is positive and the mean coalescence time is the mean holding time `1 / qₛ` plus the mean time from the next state, `h s = 1 / qₛ + ∑ₜ (q(s, t) / qₛ) h t`.
nodes.title: First-step analysis in jump-chain form

nodes.summary: The closed-form mean time to coalescence from each state: `T₀`, `T₁`, and `0` once coalesced. `firstStepEquations_iff` shows it is the unique solution of the first-step equations.
nodes.title: Closed-form mean coalescence times in the island model

nodes.summary: The state of two ancestral lineages in the island model: in the same deme, in different demes, or coalesced (absorbing).
nodes.title: State of two lineages in the island model

nodes.summary: The transition rates `q(s, t)` (`s ≠ t`) of the two-lineage structured coalescent in the finite island model with `d` demes and `M = 4Nm`, time in units of `2N` generations: same deme → coalesced at rate `1`, same deme → different demes at rate `M`, different demes → same deme at rate `M / (d - 1)`; all other rates (and the diagonal) are `0`. Meaningful for `d ≥ 2` and `M ≥ 0`.
nodes.title: Transition rates of the two-lineage structured coalescent
Slatkin's `F_ST` for the finite island model (Slatkin 1991)
Slatkin's F_ST lies strictly between 0 and 1

nodes.summary: Slatkin's (1991) `F_ST = (T̄ - T₀) / T̄` for the finite island model.
nodes.title: Slatkin's F_ST for the finite island model

nodes.summary: A sum over the three states.
nodes.title: Sum over the island-model pair states

nodes.summary: As the number of demes grows, Slatkin's `F_ST` tends to Wright's `1 / (1 + M) = 1 / (1 + 4Nm)` for every `M > 0`.
nodes.title: Many demes (Slatkin 1991)
Closed form of Slatkin's mean total coalescence time

nodes.summary: The denominator of Slatkin's `F_ST` is positive: `0 < T̄` for `d ≥ 1` and `M > 0`.
nodes.title: Positivity of Slatkin's mean total coalescence time

nodes.summary: Slatkin's mean coalescence time `T̄ = T₀ / d + (d - 1) T₁ / d` of two genes drawn from two demes chosen independently and uniformly at random.
nodes.title: Slatkin's mean total coalescence time

nodes.summary: The mean coalescence time `T₀ = d` of two lineages in the same deme (units of `2N` generations).
nodes.title: Mean coalescence time within a deme

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
